story.text: 자갈치시장은 아침부터 활기가 넘친다. 상인들의 외침과 갈매기 울음소리가 뒤섞이고, 좌판마다 싱싱한 생선이 은빛으로 반짝인다.
story.reading: ja-gal-chi-si-jang-eun a-chim-bu-teo hwal-gi-ga neom-chin-da. sang-in-deul-ui oe-chim-gwa gal-mae-gi ul-eum-so-ri-ga dwi-seok-i-go, jwa-pan-ma-da ssing-ssing-han saeng-seon-i eun-bit-eu-ro ban-jjak-in-da.
story.en: Jagalchi Market is bursting with energy from morning on. Merchants' shouts mix with the cries of seagulls, and fresh fish glint silver on every stall.

story.text: "이모, 이거 얼마고? …아이고, 너무 비싸다. 좀 깎아 주소." 선우가 능청스럽게 '흥정을' 시작한다.
story.reading: i-mo, i-geo eol-ma-go? …a-i-go, neo-mu bi-ssa-da. jom kkak-a ju-so. seon-u-ga neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge heung-jeong-eul si-jak-han-da.
story.en: "Ma'am, how much for this? …Aigo, that's too much. Cut me a deal." Sunwoo starts haggling with an easy, nonchalant confidence.

story.text: 몇 마디 주고받더니 결국 가격을 깎아낸 그가 의기양양한 얼굴로 돌아본다.
story.reading: myeot ma-di ju-go-bat-deo-ni gyeol-guk ga-gyeok-eul kkak-a-naen geu-ga ui-gi-yang-yang-han eol-gul-lo dol-a-bon-da.
story.en: After a few back-and-forth remarks, he wins a lower price and turns back around, looking triumphant.

story.text: "봤제? 이게 부산 사람 아이가. 시장은 이래 '활기차게' 다녀야 제맛이다."
story.reading: bwat-je? i-ge bu-san sa-ram a-i-ga. si-jang-eun i-rae hwal-gi-cha-ge da-nyeo-ya je-mat-i-da.
story.en: "You saw that, right? That's what a real Busan person does. You gotta walk through a market this lively for it to feel right."

story.text: 회 한 접시를 앞에 두고 나란히 앉아 있는데, 선우가 젓가락질을 멈추고 물끄러미 이쪽을 바라본다. "니 이래 앞에 앉아 있으니까—" '불쑥' 튀어나온 말에 그 자신도 놀란 눈치다.
story.reading: hoe han jeop-si-reul ap-e du-go na-ran-hi anj-a it-neun-de, seon-u-ga jeot-ga-rak-jil-eul meom-chu-go mul-kkeu-reo-mi i-jjok-eul ba-ra-bon-da. ni i-rae ap-e anj-a it-eu-ni-kka— bul-ssuk twi-eo-na-on mal-e geu ja-sin-do nol-lan nun-chi-i-da.
story.en: Sitting side by side over a plate of raw fish, Sunwoo stops mid-chopstick and stares blankly at me. "You sitting there in front of me like that—" The words blurt out of nowhere, and even he looks startled by them.

story.text: 말을 잇지 못하고 '머쓱한' 듯 뒷머리를 긁적인다. "…아니다, 됐다. 그냥 회나 무라, 식겠다."
story.reading: mal-eul it-ji mot-ha-go meo-sseuk-han deut dwit-meo-ri-reul geuk-jeok-in-da. …a-ni-da, dwaet-da. geu-nyang hoe-na mu-ra, sik-get-da.
story.en: Unable to continue, he scratches the back of his head, looking sheepish. "…No, never mind. Just eat, it'll go cold."

story.text: 애꿎은 물컵만 만지작거리며 '딴청을' 피우는 그의 귀끝이 살짝 붉다.
story.reading: ae-kkuj-eun mul-keop-man man-ji-jak-geo-ri-myeo ttan-cheong-eul pi-u-neun geu-ui gwi-kkeut-i sal-jjak but-da.
story.en: He fidgets with his water cup for no reason, feigning indifference, the tips of his ears turning faintly red.

story.text: "단어는 다 챙겼제? 대화 문제도 있으니까 잘 읽어봐라."
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da chaeng-gyeot-je? dae-hwa mun-je-do it-eu-ni-kka jal ilg-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: "Got all the words down? There's a conversation question too, so read it carefully."

words.meaning: To haggle, bargain over a price
words.example_en: There's a certain fun in haggling at the market.

words.meaning: To be lively, full of energy
words.example_en: The morning market is always lively.

words.meaning: Abruptly, out of nowhere (of words or actions)
words.example_en: He blurted out his true feelings out of nowhere.
My joke didn't land, so I felt sheepish.

words.meaning: To feign indifference, pretend not to notice
words.example_en: He avoided answering by acting like nothing was going on.

sentences.en: I haggled with the market vendor and got the price lowered.
This alley is lively no matter when you come.

sentences.ko: 그는 불쑥 고백 같은 말을 던졌다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun bul-ssuk go-baek gat-eun mal-eul deon-jyeot-da
sentences.en: He suddenly blurted out something that sounded like a confession.
Caught in my mistake, I laughed sheepishly.
Instead of answering, he acted like nothing was going on.

turns.speaker: 상인
turns.text: 총각, 오늘 회 좋다. 방어 한 마리 우째?
turns.reading: chong-gak, o-neul hoe jo-ta. bang-eo han ma-ri u-jjae?
turns.en: Young man, the raw fish is good today. How about a whole yellowtail?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이모, 저 매일 오는 단골인데 좀 더 깎아 주이소.
turns.reading: i-mo, jeo mae-il o-neun dan-gol-in-de jom deo kkak-a ju-i-so.
turns.en: Ma'am, I'm a regular who comes every day, cut me a bit more.

turns.speaker: 상인
turns.text: 아이고 능청스럽기는. 그래, 오늘만 특별히 깎아준다.
turns.reading: a-i-go neung-cheong-seu-reop-gi-neun. geu-rae, o-neul-man teuk-byeol-hi kkak-a-jun-da.
turns.en: Aigo, so smooth-talking. Fine, I'll cut it just for today.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 완전 단골처럼 구네. 진짜 여기 자주 오나 봐?
turns.reading: wan-jeon dan-gol-cheo-reom gu-ne. jin-jja yeo-gi ja-ju o-na bwa?
turns.en: You're acting like a total regular. Do you actually come here a lot?

dialogues.question: 선우가 상인에게서 값을 깎는 데 사용한 방법은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What method does Sunwoo use to get a discount from the vendor?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 자신이 단골이라고 능청스럽게 말하며 상인과 흥정해 가격을 깎아냅니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 왜 그렇게 쳐다봐? 회에 뭐 묻었어?
turns.reading: wae geu-reo-ke chyeo-da-bwa? hoe-e mwo mut-eot-eo?
turns.en: Why are you staring at me like that? Is there something on the fish?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 아니, 그게 아니고... 니 이래 앞에 앉아 있으니까 갑자기— 아이다, 아무것도 아이다.
turns.reading: a-ni, geu-ge a-ni-go... ni i-rae ap-e anj-a it-eu-ni-kka gap-ja-gi— a-i-da, a-mu-geot-do a-i-da.
turns.en: No, that's not it... it's just, with you sitting right there like that, suddenly— never mind, it's nothing.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: You just started to say something and stopped. What was it?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 몰라도 된다, 그런 거! 자, 회나 무라, 다 식는다. …아 진짜 왜 이라지 오늘.
turns.reading: mol-la-do doen-da, geu-reon geo! ja, hoe-na mu-ra, da sik-neun-da. …a jin-jja wae i-ra-ji o-neul.
turns.en: You don't need to know that! Here, just eat, it's all going cold. …Ugh, seriously, what's with me today.

dialogues.question: 선우가 갑자기 말을 멈추고 딴청을 피운 이유는 무엇일까요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo suddenly stop talking and act like nothing happened?
dialogues.correct_answer: 속마음이 무심코 튀어나올 뻔해서 당황했기 때문에
options: 속마음이 무심코 튀어나올 뻔해서 당황했기 때문에
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 진심이 불쑥 튀어나올 뻔하자 스스로도 당황해 얼버무리며 딴청으로 넘어갑니다.
